prompts.name: life_modeling_start
prompts.title: Start Meaning Model modeling
prompts.description: Begin with the operational protocol, a purpose-specific profile and an example; the papers carry the reasons behind the rules.

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.description: One of creative_story, source_reconstruction, person_reflection, observation, forecasting, counterfactual.

arguments.name: sessionMode
arguments.description: One of first_use, repeat_same_domain, new_domain, consequential or continuation. Use continuation when you continue recorded work in this server; new_domain or consequential start a new reading record.

prompts.name: life_general_modeling_start
prompts.title: Build and revise a general-purpose world model
prompts.description: Model macro context and long-term developments before local processes, with optional Jev estimation and automatic graph ingestion. Storytelling is independent and opt-in.

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.description: One of observation, forecasting or counterfactual. observation also covers explaining why something observed happened; forecasting adds testable values after the evidence cutoff; counterfactual holds an alternative premise apart from the accepted history.

arguments.name: sessionMode
arguments.description: One of first_use, repeat_same_domain, new_domain, consequential or continuation. Use continuation when you continue recorded work in this server: the prompt then starts with reading the construction record.

prompts.name: life_story_scene_start
prompts.title: Develop a scene with the optional storytelling add-on
prompts.description: Establish initial story settings and human involvement separately, reuse explicit delegation, then model the world first (candidate worlds, their opening, implications and a route), then author outlook and character life trends, and prepare, review, and commit scenes within the agreed role.

prompts.name: life_story_structure_explore
prompts.title: Explore story structures or names from an everyday word
prompts.description: Ask the invoking LLM for structures or story-fitting names inspired by a random common word or a supplied seed. Use targetKind name when naming new characters or places. Create the model and story graph first; record the returned seed and authored alternatives with life_story_author_record.

prompts.name: life_story_purpose_review
prompts.title: Review a chapter or section’s purpose
prompts.description: At completed chapters, turning points, or consequential revisions, ask the invoking LLM what the unit aims to accomplish and whether it succeeds. Review anticipation, change, adaptation and the selected author model’s prose effects where relevant. Judgments are advisory.

prompts.name: life_story_deepen
prompts.title: Deepen an existing story and its model
prompts.description: Bind existing prose and model evidence for a separate revision pass. Preserve the baseline, record voice and depth findings as Understanding Nodes, revise locally or structurally within delegation, and compare the final canonical result.

arguments.name: focusNodeId
arguments.description: Stored outline or plan identifying the consequential choices and outcomes being reviewed; may be the story root if its text supplies this.

arguments.name: rootId
arguments.description: Existing rendered work or unit to deepen, contained in storyRootId.
